row.notes: Picks the plan pointer from the 3D table at +0x128 indexed by ints +0x178 (x0x20), +0x17c (x0x10), +0x180 (x8) and copies its stint vector (plan+8..+0x10, 0x38-byte stints) into the working vector at +0xd0/+0xd8/+0xe0 (allocator +0xc8). Clears flag bits in +0x268 (mask 0xfffffffdff77b07e), sets +0x230 = first stint field +0x18 (0x7fffffff if empty), +0x23c = max(stints,1)-1, +0x24c = 0, +0x1d8 = 0xffffffff00000004, then via the car tyre component (k_Sess_TyreComponentType, car index byte +0xc4, session +0x10) fits the first stint compound, stores max of the 4 wheel wear floats of the fitted set in +0x220 and stint0+0x30, and for later stints searches the per-compound tyre set lists at +0x188[compound] (0x1c-byte sets, available flag +0x19) in a preference order from tables 0x14585bbf0..c20 to select a set (tail jumps into tyre component set-select code writing +0x9c70/+0x9c78). Stint fields: +0 compound, +0x14 set age/-1 unassigned, +0x24 set index byte. Good hook to observe which AI strategy plan becomes active.
